name: Victory event
goalName: Create a victory event for the basketball arcade game mode
goal: When a round ends, nothing really happens so far. The winner is displayed and the remaining basketballs explode. Adding a victory event adds excitement to the game feel.

approach.text: I decided to create a confetti effect like shown here:<<image 12.png>>To make it more arcade like and basketball like, I decided to use basketballs instead of confetti. I created a second prefab of the basketballs with a trail that includes more colors and extra bounciness. Next, I created a script to shoot basketballs at different speeds from the bottom corners.

result: The result is achieved using the code shown here:<<image 13.png>>The victory basketball code is similar to regular basketballs, without the score event. They automatically explode after 3 seconds. The following video shows the result in action:<<video https://www.youtube.com/embed/a-F_MEBzQLw>>
